_why: Key names the owner ordered deleted. A commit that re-introduces one is restoring art he has told us three times to destroy. Deleting is not enough on its own: a lane that thinks a sheet is gutted restores it wholesale from an older commit, the manifest and png agree, no index is out of range, and the guard passes it. That happened at 20:51 on Aug 22 while he was playing, which is why he kept seeing frames that had already been deleted twice.
_scope: KAEL ONLY, on purpose. Several other sheets are churning between gutted and restored right now (executioner 0 keys, shin 43 as this was written), so a list built from their history would record live keys as purged and refuse every future commit. Add a fighter here only from a state you have verified.
_refilled: A name leaves this list when NEW art is packed under it. The list exists to stop an old SHEET being restored, not to retire a key name forever — the engine reads these names and a fighter needs them.
